source_material.claim: Local Android native PDF recovered once after v1 refusal.
source_material.evidence: 1 October record: connected Android native PDF v1 GET401 followed by exactly one real v2 renewal and matching PDF hash passed locally.

source_material.claim: Clearing a client cache alone proves server-side URL revocation.
source_material.evidence: An on-device private root was absent after tenant switch; this excerpt contains no server request or authority result.

source_material.claim: The current Android build passes based on an older test run.
source_material.evidence: This is a historical pre-change Android build PASS. No build was run after the current change.

source_material.claim: The local WebView file flow opens the real Android share sheet.
source_material.evidence: Repaired permanent Android chorister WebView file flow: one renewal, exact65905B/hash and actual Android share sheet PASS; no external share executed.

source_material.claim: A confirmed403 stops native recovery without a new ticket.
source_material.evidence: The recovery helper accepts only HEAD200/401 or transport uncertainty for renewal; every other observed status throws before the lease call.

source_material.claim: All five reader families have been tested concurrently under revocation.
source_material.evidence: This excerpt records a single family serial GET and HEAD under revocation. It does not describe concurrent calls or other families.

state.boundary: This asks whether evidence establishes a claim, not whether the actual system passed. Neither absence of proof nor contradictory proof supports the claim.
